slots.label: Series, sigma notation and infinite sums

items.q: What is the common ratio of 3; 6; 12; 24; …?
items.qAf: Wat is die gemeenskaplike verhouding van 3; 6; 12; 24; …?
items.explain: Each term is 2 times the previous term, so r = 2.
items.explainAf: Elke term is 2 keer die vorige term, dus r = 2.

items.q: The 5th term of an arithmetic sequence is 23 and the 9th term is 39. Find the common difference.
items.qAf: Die 5de term van ’n rekenkundige ry is 23 en die 9de term is 39. Vind die gemeenskaplike verskil.

items.q: A geometric sequence has T2 = 12 and T4 = 108, with all terms positive. Find T1.
items.qAf: ’n Meetkundige ry het T2 = 12 en T4 = 108, met alle terme positief. Vind T1.
items.explainAf: r² = 108 ÷ 12 = 9, dus r = 3 (positief). Dan is T1 = 12 ÷ 3 = 4.

items.q: Evaluate the sum: Σ (2k − 1) for k = 1 to 5.
items.qAf: Bereken die som: Σ (2k − 1) vir k = 1 tot 5.

items.q: Determine the sum to infinity of 9 + 3 + 1 + 1/3 + …
items.qAf: Bepaal die som tot oneindig van 9 + 3 + 1 + 1/3 + …

items.q: How many terms of 5 + 8 + 11 + … must be added so that the sum exceeds 500?
items.qAf: Hoeveel terme van 5 + 8 + 11 + … moet bymekaar getel word sodat die som 500 oorskry?
items.explain: Sn = n(3n + 7) ÷ 2. S17 = 493 and S18 = 549, so 18 terms are needed.
items.explainAf: Sn = n(3n + 7) ÷ 2. S17 = 493 en S18 = 549, dus is 18 terme nodig.
